prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent sprite for an interactive medieval blacksmith hammer cursor, Alvorada Cinzenta dark fantasy RPG workshop.
Primary request: one substantial professional blacksmith forging hammer, beautifully painted realistic fantasy game inventory art, strong believable weight and readable silhouette. Broad rectangular forged steel head with a large flat striking face and shorter cross-peen back, thick aged ash wood handle with a small dark leather grip; carefully made physical construction, warm copper edge highlights and cool steel reflections. Not a claw hammer and not a fantasy war weapon. Three quarter side view, all parts visible, no hand. Diagonal orientation: lower grip end near x20% y88%, handle runs toward the head near x72% y27%. Head occupies about 38% of image width, handle about 65% of image height. Keep image centered, entire silhouette with small clear margin on every edge. The lowest striking corner of the steel head must be distinct and easy to align with a hot metal workpiece during a clockwise swing. High detail metal and wooden material texture, clean shaped head with visible flat face, no ornate patterns.
Lighting: warm forge glow on right rim, neutral cool fill, crisp edges and rich material shading.
Background: true transparent alpha, no floor, no cast shadow baked outside the tool. No background, no other objects, no sparks, no text, no border, no watermark. Only a single hammer, one head, one handle.
notes: Cabeça larga de ferraria, alfa transparente. Original e arte anterior preservados.
